hidden_objection_layers_add.text: He knows he did to you what his father did to him, and it is unbearable to be seen knowing it.

second_delayed_cost.text: He did not come to the airport. Your mother came alone.

inherit_skull_debt.opening_line: Your Hemu-mama called. He says you spoke to him like a recovery agent. [He doesn't look up.] Is this what London teaches?

t2.line: Career. [He turns toward the kitchen.] Shobha! Come and tell your child what it did to you when your brother went to Dubai. Tell them. [To you] Ask her what it did to her.

tells.anchor: phrase:Ask her what it did to her.
tells.reading: Surprise tactic: he's bringing your mother in as a third party.
tells.false_positive: Your mother really was hurt when her brother left. It's a real story.

choices_add.text: Baba. Aai can tell me herself, later. Right now it's you and me. What's it doing to you?

line_by_state.line: [He turns the photograph face-up. Looks at it. Turns it down again.] He took my letter. And I didn't even need to take yours. I just waited, every day, for you to say it. That's worse. I know that's worse. [Pause.] Don't look at me like that. Ramu, enough.
My father wanted accountancy. I wanted COEP. He took my letter from the post. What is it worth, if nobody wants it.

choices_add.text: [say nothing for a moment. Then:] I'm still going, Baba. And I still want your help with the tax. Both things.
